subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配体分类：下列配体属于哪一种 L/X 类型：1,5-cyclooctadiene (η²,η²)（cod）？
A. L₂
B. X₃
C. X₂
D. L₂X
explanation: cod (1,5-cyclooctadiene (η²,η²)) is an L₂ ligand: each L gives 2 electrons and each X one, so 4 electrons in the covalent count (4 in the ionic count).
